title: USB Audio Out
author: irpina
description: The Octatrack as a USB audio input (UAC2, 44.1 kHz, 24-bit) on its own USB port, as a function of usb-ot. What the stream carries is a setting, USB AUDIO LAYOUT in the MODS menu (with the settings companion; otherwise the default): MAIN, MAIN+CUE, MASTER (track 8), TRACKS (1-8, 16 channels), TRACKS+MAIN+CUE (20 channels, the default) or OFF (no USB audio interface at all). It applies at the next power-up. It combines with USB MIDI. Built on what sambanks/octabam's USB audio found (the taps, the MAIN and CUE alignment, the rate servo, the first poll's cushion).
